senses.gloss: ch. same, to be dry, to dry out.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:13">Targ. Gen. VIII, 13</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:1:4">Y. Sabb. V, beg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>כדו נגיב אינון וכ׳</he> when it is dry, they name it Egyptian bean; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:3:4">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:6:4">Y. Gitt. VII, end, 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ונ׳ נהרא</he> the canal dried up.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>דיִיגַּב וכ׳</he> that the canal may dry up; a. e.
B. Mets. 24ᵃ ונ׳ בגלימא וכ׳ wiped (his hands) on his neighbor’s cloak; a. e.—Part. pass. מְנַגַּב; f. מְנַגְּבָא parched.
